findings.finding: semantic_integrity and predefined ablations can remain NOT_RUN while the runner can still reach PASS because semantic_critical_violations defaults to 0.
findings.effect: false PASS possible for untested hard ACs

findings.finding: external evaluator does not evaluate dictionary_target_recall, false_bias_rate, context_false_substitution_delta, or semantic integrity, despite these being hard ACs in the authoritative plan.
findings.effect: full PASS can be claimed without full AC coverage

findings.finding: technical_key_term_accuracy is computed by checking whether the entire reference sentence is a substring of the hypothesis instead of scoring declared key terms.
findings.effect: technical accuracy metric is invalid and can materially change disposition

findings.finding: WER/CER scoring is not normalized for case, punctuation, or Unicode normalization. Qwen formatting differences can be counted as recognition errors.
findings.effect: false failure or distorted accuracy is possible

findings.finding: current FLEURS evaluation set is too small to support comparison against the historical 6.23% OpenASR average WER or an Aqua-class accuracy claim.
findings.effect: statistical validity absent; a pass/fail from one general utterance per language is not decision-grade

findings.finding: streaming first_partial_ms feeds 500 ms chunks as fast as compute allows, without real-time pacing. It therefore measures compute time rather than user-perceived partial latency.
p50/p95 streaming latency can be calculated from only a few single runs, conflicting with the original 100+ warm-run latency requirement.
findings.effect: latency percentile evidence is not reliable

findings.finding: model ID is pinned by name only, without model revision/hash in evidence.
findings.effect: results are not fully reproducible if upstream weights change

findings.finding: Japanese Aqua non-inferiority AC has no paired Aqua evidence path in the current evaluator and remains blocked.

reclassification.new_interpretation: infrastructure and contract self-tests PASS only; product accuracy/latency equivalence unproven

required_before_product_PASS: fail closed on every hard AC that is NOT_RUN
define and score explicit technical key terms
expand benchmark fixture counts and restore minimum run counts
measure streaming latency with real-time pacing and 100+ warm runs
